SELECT * FROM (
SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(n.nspname) || $1 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(p.proname)
         || $2 || pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || $3 AS signature,
       n.nspname, p.proname, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),
       CASE p.prokind WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE $6 END,
       l.lanname, pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), COALESCE(r.rolsuper, $7) AS superuser,
       (SELECT pg_catalog.substring(c, $8) FROM pg_catalog.unnest(p.proconfig) AS c
         WHERE c LIKE $9 LIMIT $10) AS search_path,
       EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, pg_catalog.acldefault($12, p.proowner))) a
                WHERE a.grantee = $13 AND a.privilege_type = $14) AS public_execute
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner
 WHERE p.prosecdef AND p.prokind IN ($15 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname NOT IN ($16 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname !~ $17
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $18 FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d
                    WHERE d.classid = $19::pg_catalog.regclass
                      AND d.objid = p.oid AND d.deptype = $20)
) f
 ORDER BY f.search_path IS NULL DESC, f.superuser DESC, f.public_execute DESC, f.signature
 LIMIT $21

SELECT a.attname AS column_name,
               coalesce(bt.typname, t.typname) AS udt_name,
               information_schema._pg_char_max_length(information_schema._pg_truetypid(a.*, t.*), information_schema._pg_truetypmod(a.*, t.*)) AS character_maximum_length,
               CASE WHEN a.attnotnull OR t.typtype = $1 AND t.typnotnull THEN $2
                    ELSE $3
               END AS is_nullable
          FROM pg_attribute a
          JOIN pg_class c
            ON a.attrelid = c.oid
          JOIN pg_namespace nc
            ON c.relnamespace = nc.oid
          JOIN pg_type t
            ON a.atttypid = t.oid
     LEFT JOIN (pg_type bt JOIN pg_namespace nbt ON bt.typnamespace = nbt.oid)
            ON t.typtype = $4::"char"
           AND t.typbasetype = bt.oid
         WHERE nc.nspname = current_schema
           AND a.attnum > $5
           AND NOT a.attisdropped
           AND c.relkind IN ($6 /*, ... */)
           AND (pg_has_role(c.relowner, $7::text) OR has_column_privilege(c.oid, a.attnum, $8))

SELECT pg_catalog.current_setting($1),
       (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)
          FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p
          JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
          JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang
         WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($2 /*, ... */)
           AND n.nspname !~ $3
           AND l.lanname NOT IN ($4 /*, ... */)
           AND p.prokind IN ($5 /*, ... */)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $6 FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d
                            WHERE d.classid = $7::pg_catalog.regclass
                              AND d.objid = p.oid AND d.deptype = $8))

SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(n.nspname) || $1 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(c.relname) || $2 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(con.conname),
       n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname,
       pn.nspname || $3 || pc.relname,
       (SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(a.attname, $4 ORDER BY k.ord)
          FROM pg_catalog.unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k (attnum, ord)
          JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum),
       (SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(pg_catalog.quote_ident(a.attname), $5 ORDER BY k.ord)
          FROM pg_catalog.unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k (attnum, ord)
          JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum),
       CASE WHEN c.relkind = $6
            THEN COALESCE((WITH RECURSIVE tree (relid) AS (
                                SELECT c.oid
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT i.inhrelid FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits i JOIN tree t ON i.inhparent = t.relid)
                           SELECT pg_catalog.sum(pc.relpages::pg_catalog.int8)
                             FROM tree JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.oid = tree.relid
                            WHERE pc.relkind <> $7), $8)
            ELSE c.relpages END::pg_catalog.int8 * pg_catalog.current_setting($9)::pg_catalog.int8 AS bytes
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.oid = con.confrelid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = pc.relnamespace
 WHERE con.contype = $10
   AND con.conparentid = $11
   AND n.nspname NOT IN ($12 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname !~ $13
   AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT $14
         FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i
         JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
         JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam
        WHERE i.indrelid = con.conrelid
          AND i.indisvalid
          AND i.indpred IS NULL
          AND am.amname IN ($15 /*, ... */)
          AND pg_catalog.cardinality(con.conkey) <= i.indnkeyatts
          AND (pg_catalog.string_to_array(i.indkey::pg_catalog.text, $16)::pg_catalog.int2[])[$17:pg_catalog.cardinality(con.conkey)] @> con.conkey
          AND (pg_catalog.string_to_array(i.indkey::pg_catalog.text, $18)::pg_catalog.int2[])[$19:pg_catalog.cardinality(con.conkey)] <@ con.conkey)
 ORDER BY bytes DESC, 1
 LIMIT $20

SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(n.nspname) || $1 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(c.relname) || $2 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(t.tgname),
       n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname, t.tgenabled::pg_catalog.text, t.tgisinternal,
       pn.nspname || $3 || p.proname, t.tgtype::pg_catalog.int4,
       COALESCE(con.conname, $4), COALESCE(con.contype::pg_catalog.text, $5)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = p.pronamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint con ON con.oid = t.tgconstraint
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_trigger parent ON parent.oid = t.tgparentid
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($6 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname !~ $7
   AND (NOT t.tgisinternal OR t.tgenabled = $8)
   AND (parent.oid IS NULL OR parent.tgenabled <> t.tgenabled)
 ORDER BY (t.tgenabled = $9) DESC, t.tgisinternal DESC, 1
 LIMIT $10

SELECT s.schemaname, s.relname,
       COALESCE(s.seq_scan, $1), COALESCE(s.seq_tup_read, $2), COALESCE(s.idx_scan, $3), COALESCE(s.idx_tup_fetch, $4),
       COALESCE(s.n_tup_ins, $5), COALESCE(s.n_tup_upd, $6), COALESCE(s.n_tup_del, $7), COALESCE(s.n_tup_hot_upd, $8),
       COALESCE(s.n_live_tup, $9), COALESCE(s.n_dead_tup, $10), COALESCE(s.n_mod_since_analyze, $11),
       s.last_vacuum, s.last_autovacuum, s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze,
       COALESCE(s.autovacuum_count, $12), COALESCE(s.autoanalyze_count, $13),
       COALESCE(c.relpages, $14), COALESCE(c.reltuples, $15), age(c.relfrozenxid),
       (GREATEST(c.relpages, $16)::bigint + GREATEST(COALESCE(tc.relpages, $17), $18)::bigint) * current_setting($19)::bigint,
       c.oid
FROM pg_stat_user_tables s
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = s.relid
LEFT JOIN pg_class tc ON tc.oid = c.reltoastrelid
WHERE c.relkind = $20
  AND c.relpersistence <> $21

SELECT s.schemaname, s.relname, s.indexrelname,

       COALESCE(io.idx_blks_read,$4), COALESCE(io.idx_blks_hit,$5),
       (GREATEST(ic.relpages, $6)::bigint * current_setting($7)::bigint),
       ix.indisunique, ix.indisprimary, ix.indisvalid, s.indexrelid,
       s.last_idx_scan, $8::timestamptz,

FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s
JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = s.indexrelid

WITH RECURSIVE group_imply(gid, hid) AS (
                        SELECT gid, hid
                          FROM res_groups_implied_rel
                         UNION
                        SELECT i.gid, r.hid
                          FROM res_groups_implied_rel r
                          JOIN group_imply i ON (i.hid = r.gid)
                    )
                    INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid)
                         SELECT i.hid, r.uid
                           FROM group_imply i, res_groups_users_rel r
                          WHERE r.gid = i.gid
                            AND i.gid = $1
                         EXCEPT
                         SELECT r.gid, r.uid
                           FROM res_groups_users_rel r
                           JOIN group_imply i ON (r.gid = i.hid)
                          WHERE i.gid = $2
                    RETURNING gid, uid

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT queryid,
           sum(calls)::bigint             AS calls,
           sum(total_exec_time)::float8   AS total_exec_time,
           sum(rows)::bigint              AS rows,
           sum(shared_blks_hit)::bigint   AS shared_blks_hit,
           sum(shared_blks_read)::bigint  AS shared_blks_read,
           sum(wal_bytes)::bigint         AS wal_bytes,
           sum(temp_blks_written)::bigint AS temp_blks_written,
           min(query)                     AS query
      FROM "public"."pg_stat_statements"
     WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database())
       AND queryid IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY queryid
),
ranked AS (
    (SELECT queryid FROM agg ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT $1)
    UNION
    (SELECT queryid FROM agg ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT $2)
)
SELECT a.queryid, a.calls, a.total_exec_time, a.rows,
       a.shared_blks_hit, a.shared_blks_read, a.wal_bytes, a.temp_blks_written,
       CASE WHEN octet_length(a.query) <= $3 THEN a.query END,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM agg)
  FROM agg a
  JOIN ranked USING (queryid)
 ORDER BY a.queryid

WITH links AS (
    SELECT d.objid AS seqid, d.refobjid AS relid, d.refobjsubid AS attnum,
           CASE d.deptype WHEN $1 THEN $2 ELSE $3 END AS rank
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_sequence ps ON ps.seqrelid = d.objid
     WHERE d.classid = $4::pg_catalog.regclass
       AND d.refclassid = $5::pg_catalog.regclass
       AND d.deptype IN ($6 /*, ... */)
       AND d.refobjsubid > $7
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.refobjid, ad.adrelid, ad.adnum, $8
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_sequence ps ON ps.seqrelid = d.refobjid
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad ON ad.oid = d.objid
     WHERE d.classid = $9::pg_catalog.regclass
       AND d.refclassid = $10::pg_catalog.regclass
  ), cols AS (
    SELECT l.seqid, l.relid, l.attnum, l.rank, tn.nspname, tc.relname, a.attname,
           pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS typname,
           tc.relispartition, GREATEST(tc.reltuples, $11)::pg_catalog.float8 AS reltuples,
           CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(t.typbasetype, $12), t.oid)
                WHEN $13::pg_catalog.regtype THEN $14::pg_catalog.int8
                WHEN $15::pg_catalog.regtype THEN $16::pg_catalog.int8
                WHEN $17::pg_catalog.regtype THEN $18::pg_catalog.int8 END AS type_max,
           CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(t.typbasetype, $19), t.oid)
                WHEN $20::pg_catalog.regtype THEN ($21)::pg_catalog.int8
                WHEN $22::pg_catalog.regtype THEN ($23)::pg_catalog.int8
                WHEN $24::pg_catalog.regtype THEN ($25)::pg_catalog.int8 END AS type_min
      FROM links l
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class tc ON tc.oid = l.relid
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = l.relid AND a.attnum = l.attnum AND NOT a.attisdropped
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
  )
SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(n.nspname) || $26 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(c.relname),
       c.oid, n.nspname, c.relname, pg_catalog.format_type(s.seqtypid, $27),
       s.seqstart, s.seqincrement, s.seqmin, s.seqmax, s.seqcycle,
       pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(c.oid, $28)
         AND NOT (c.relpersistence = $29 AND pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery()),
       COALESCE(col.nspname, $30), COALESCE(col.relname, $31), COALESCE(col.attname, $32),
       COALESCE(col.typname, $33), COALESCE(col.rank, $34), col.type_max, col.type_min,
       (SELECT pg_catalog.count(DISTINCT (x.relid, x.attnum)) FROM cols x WHERE x.seqid = c.oid)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_sequence s
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = s.seqrelid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT x.*
         FROM cols x
        WHERE x.seqid = c.oid
        ORDER BY x.type_max NULLS LAST, x.relispartition, x.rank, x.nspname, x.relname, x.attname
        LIMIT $35) col ON $36
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($37 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname !~ $38
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.seqincrement > $39
               THEN LEAST(s.seqmax, COALESCE(col.type_max, s.seqmax))::pg_catalog.numeric - s.seqstart
               ELSE s.seqstart - GREATEST(s.seqmin, COALESCE(col.type_min, s.seqmin))::pg_catalog.numeric END,
          col.reltuples DESC NULLS LAST, 1
 LIMIT $40

WITH st AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (schemaname, tablename, attname)
         schemaname, tablename, attname, n_distinct, null_frac, avg_width
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_stats
   WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($1 /*, ... */)
   ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, attname, inherited)
SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(n.nspname) || $2 || pg_catalog.quote_ident(c.relname),
       n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind::pg_catalog.text,
       c.reltuples::pg_catalog.float8, c.relpages::pg_catalog.int8,
       COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_strip_nulls(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                         $3, a.attname, $4, a.attnum,
                         $5, pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
                         $6, t.typlen, $7, a.attnotnull,
                         $8, st.n_distinct, $9, st.null_frac,
                         $10, st.avg_width) ORDER BY a.attnum))::pg_catalog.text
                   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
                   JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
                   LEFT JOIN st ON st.schemaname = n.nspname AND st.tablename = c.relname AND st.attname = a.attname
                  WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > $11 AND NOT a.attisdropped), $12)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
 WHERE c.relkind IN ($13 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname NOT IN ($14 /*, ... */)
   AND n.nspname !~ $15
 ORDER BY c.relpages DESC, 1
 LIMIT $16

WITH sub_followers AS (
        SELECT fol.partner_id AS pid,
               fol.id AS fid,
               fol.res_id AS res_id,
               $1 as is_follower,
               COALESCE(subrel.follow, $2) AS subtype_follower,
               COALESCE(subrel.internal, $3) AS internal
          FROM mail_followers fol
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT $4 AS follow,
                   subtype.internal AS internal
              FROM mail_followers_mail_message_subtype_rel m
         LEFT JOIN mail_message_subtype subtype ON subtype.id = m.mail_message_subtype_id
             WHERE m.mail_followers_id = fol.id AND m.mail_message_subtype_id = $5
            ) subrel ON $6
         WHERE fol.res_model = $7
               AND fol.res_id IN ($8)

     UNION ALL

        SELECT res_partner.id AS pid,
               $9 AS fid,
               $10 AS res_id,
               $11 as is_follower,
               $12 as subtype_follower,
               $13 as internal
          FROM res_partner
         WHERE res_partner.id = ANY($14)
    )
    SELECT partner.id as pid,
